rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the medieval spear carried by a soldier or horseman.

example.english: The museum has a medieval lance used by soldiers.
example.traditional: 博物館入面擺住一支中世紀士兵用過嘅長矛。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 baai2 zyu6 jat1 zi1 zung1 sai3 gei2 si6 bing1 jung6 gwo3 ge3 coeng4 maau4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the wooden lance used in jousting or tilting.

example.english: In the novel, each knight charges the other on horseback with a lance.
example.traditional: 小說入面，每位騎士都騎馬用騎槍衝向對方。
example.jyutping: siu2 syut3 jap6 min6 mui5 wai6 ke4 si6 dou1 ke4 maa5 jung6 ke4 coeng1 cung1 hoeng3 deoi3 fong1
